wish: someone should make an app that generates cafe or library ambience noise
spec:
Synthesizes endless cafe or library background sound live: voice murmur, cup clinks, espresso steam, page turns and footsteps, rain, room hum.
Tap a preset (Cafe, Library, Rainy cafe, Just hum), press Play, then fine-tune each layer with its slider; an optional timer stops it; mix is remembered.
No recordings and no network: every sound is generated in the browser, so it is never a real cafe recording.
notes: All layers synthesized with Web Audio; no audio files.
